nphi.title: ICMR/DHR regional dialogue on strengthening health research systems
nphi.with: National health research bodies of Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Timor-Leste
nphi.summary: ICMR offered ethics forms and free training to partners and agreed regular exchanges and joint capacity building on AMR, NCDs, One Health and field epidemiology.

nphi.title: CDC Southeast Asia Regional Office
nphi.summary: CDC's SEA regional office in Hanoi (2021) coordinates seven bilateral country offices and ASEAN partnerships on AMR, One Health, border health, lab systems, emergency management and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: APCOVE – Asia Pacific Consortium of Veterinary Epidemiology (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand veterinary schools; national animal health services
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded consortium set up in 2020 to build veterinary epidemiology capacity for animal and zoonotic disease surveillance in eight Asia-Pacific countries.

nphi.title: ARIA-RISE – Regional Immunisation Support and Engagement
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS) – Australian Regional Immunisation Alliance (ARIA)
nphi.with: 20+ Australian research institutions (Menzies, MCRI, Burnet, Kirby, ANU, Telethon Kids); WHO; UNICEF; Gavi; regional ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded alliance hosted by NCIRS that supports immunisation programmes in the Pacific and Southeast Asia, including COVID-19 vaccine roll-out plans, measles outbreak support and immunisation training (RISE-2 continuing).

nphi.title: IMR as SEAMEO TROPMED Regional Centre for Microbiology, Parasitology and Entomology
nphi.summary: IMR has hosted the SEAMEO TROPMED regional centre for microbiology, parasitology and entomology since 1967, running regional diploma courses for Southeast Asian health professionals; it is also a WHO collaborating centre for vector…

nphi.title: NCIRS support to middle-income countries on NITAGs and immunisation provider education
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS)
nphi.with: Ministries of health; national immunisation technical advisory groups; Sydney Vietnam Institute; Gavi
nphi.summary: Gavi-funded two-year project in which NCIRS supports NITAG strengthening, including twinning between advisory groups, and builds country-led immunisation training in Fiji, Timor-Leste and Viet Nam.

nphi.title: INSA support to Portuguese-speaking countries for COVID-19 testing
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Doutor Ricardo Jorge (INSA)
nphi.with: National public health laboratories and institutes of Mozambique, Angola, Guinea-Bissau, Cabo Verde, São Tomé and Príncipe and Timor-Leste
nphi.summary: In 2020 INSA helped Lusophone African countries set up and validate SARS-CoV-2 testing (technical guidance, comparison testing, remote training) and exchanged test information with Timor-Leste, coordinating further support with Camões.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Timor-Leste
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INSP); Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries
nphi.summary: With Fleming Fund country-grant support, Menzies works with Timor-Leste's National Health Laboratory, INSP and ministries to build microbiology and AMR surveillance capacity.

nphi.title: VIDRL mentoring of new National Influenza Centres in Bhutan, Maldives and Timor-Leste
nphi.actor: Victorian Infectious Diseases Reference Laboratory (VIDRL) – WHO CC for Reference and Research on Influenza
nphi.with: National public health laboratories of Bhutan, Maldives and Timor-Leste; WHO SEARO; US CDC WHO CC
nphi.summary: Together with WHO and the US CDC WHO Collaborating Centre, VIDRL trained and mentored senior staff at the public health laboratories of Bhutan, the Maldives and Timor-Leste. All three laboratories were then recognised as WHO National…

nphi.title: Workshop for field epidemiology officials from Asian countries (CFETP, MOFCOM-funded)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; Ministry of Commerce (aid training)
nphi.summary: CFETP hosted a three-week aid-funded workshop in Beijing for 20 field epidemiology officials from seven Asian countries. It was the second such workshop for Asian countries, and a 2015 round followed.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: STRONG TL – strengthening surveillance and operational research in Timor-Leste
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (National Institute of Health) Timor-Leste; Universidade Nacional Timor Lorosa'e; NT Department of Health; ANU; Royal Darwin Hospital
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$2.12 million) to improve disease surveillance, national communicable disease guidelines and operational research capacity with Timor-Leste's National Institute of Health.
